body:
## Summary

Adds `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg-agentic-mtp`: nine GLM-5.2 MXFP4 AgentX points on MI355X with ATOM prefill/decode disaggregation behind AToMesh, Mooncake RDMA from prefill to decode, MTP, and the prefill's prefix cache in a Mooncake Store. The current ATOM entry stops at concurrency 10 on one node; these points cover concurrency 12-128.

Every point has one CPP4 prefill worker (PP4 x TP1 on GPUs 0-3, layers split 20/20/20/18):

| Points | Nodes | Decode | MTP | Mooncake Store 0.3.13 on the prefill node |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C56, C72, C96, C112, C128 | 1 (1P1D) | TP4 + DCP4 on GPUs 4-7 of the prefill node | 3 | one shared pool, 2 x 768 GiB |
| C56 | 3 (1P2D) | 2 x TP4 + DCP4, a node each | 4 | a pool per NIC, 4 x 349 GiB |
| C12, C16, C24 | 4 (1P3D) | 3 x TP4, a node each | 5 | a pool per NIC, 4 x 349 GiB |

- **Mooncake Store.** The masters and owners run as `generic` services on the prefill node. 1P1D, like ATOM's CI, has one master and two 768 GiB owners, one per NUMA node, shared by all four PP stages; each owner registers on rdma0-3, and the prefill sets `MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY` so each stage reaches an owner through the NIC of its own name on this rail-isolated fabric. 1P2D and 1P3D start a master and a 349 GiB owner for each prefill-stage NIC (rdma0-3), so each stage reads its own pool on its own rail. An owner registers its segment in 64 GiB regions, which the ionic driver maps only when they are all 2 MiB pages. `host_setup` therefore reserves HugeTLB pages through the cluster's `hugepage_sanity.sh`, as the DSv4 UMBP recipe does: the owners' pages plus 2% on top of the pages host services already hold (5656 on the `mi355x-amds` nodes seen so far). It reserves them only on the head node, where srtctl starts the prefill (it matches the node's addresses against `SLURM_LAUNCH_NODE_IPADDR` and fails if srun did not set it), checks each NUMA node's share, and teardown releases the pages. Owners set `MC_STORE_USE_HUGEPAGE=1`, which fails instead of falling back to 4 KiB pages, and run `ulimit -l unlimited` first: the remapped container root lacks host `CAP_IPC_LOCK`, so registering the segment counts against `RLIMIT_MEMLOCK`.
- **DRAM budget.** With #4211, `dram-utilization: 1.0` gives each 4-GPU server 1499 GB. The 1P1D decode shares the prefill's node, so its owners hold 1649 GB, 825 GB per NUMA node, within the prefill's and the decode's shares. The 1P2D and 1P3D decodes run on their own nodes, so those owners hold the prefill's 1499 GB.
- **Why no LMCache.** An LMCache prefill sometimes hung for good in the startup barrier after registering its 1 TiB pinned pool (3 of 8 starts on `mi355x-amds`); a Store prefill never has. On the same points the Store matched or beat it (see below).
- **Model and memory.** `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4` has no staged copy on `mi355x-amds`; as the single-node GLM-5.2 points do, workers read it from each node's local hub cache (`/var/lib/hf-hub-cache` mounted at `$HF_HOME/hub`, the only path srtctl's pre-download sees), and srtctl fills the first node's cache before they start. Each point's `host_setup` re-runs the cluster's `setup.sh`, which drops the page cache, before reserving hugepages. The five 1P1D points share one recipe variant, so the sweep runs one GSM8K eval for them.
- **srt-slurm patch.** srtctl's ATOM backend passes the worker's GPU count as `-tp`, so the PP4 prefill would launch as `-tp 4 --pipeline-parallel-size 4` (16 ranks on 4 GPUs). `runners/srt-slurm/patches/604-atom-tp-from-pp.patch` carries NVIDIA/srt-slurm#604, which divides by the pipeline and prefill-context stages; it still applies on the v2.59.1 pin. Drop the patch once the pin includes that PR.
- **Cache accounting.** The branch carries #3964 (cherry-picked as `4f75d941`, author Chun Fang), so this PR's sweep computes the ATOM P/D cache rates with it: prefill endpoints only, and the Store's rate from `atom:prefix_cache_offload_tokens`. Drop it once #3964 merges.
- The image is `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202610131249`, pinned by digest (ROCm/ATOM 6fd1bb1be).

**Runs on `mi355x-amds`.** Sweep 39028510364 ran this layout all green. Throughput per GPU, TTFT p50/p90:

| Point | tok/s/GPU | TTFT p50 / p90 | GSM8K (strict) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1P1D C56 | 31,067 | 1.45 / 2.85 s | |
| 1P1D C72 | 38,487 | 1.93 / 4.00 s | |
| 1P1D C96 | 42,884 | 3.73 / 11.35 s | |
| 1P1D C112 | 39,245 | 14.78 / 26.70 s | |
| 1P1D C128 | 39,933 | 16.02 / 37.22 s | 0.962 |
| 1P2D C56 | 24,030 | 1.34 / 2.71 s | 0.965 |
| 1P3D C12 | 3,974 | 0.94 / 1.80 s | |
| 1P3D C16 | 6,481 | 0.94 / 2.00 s | 0.972 |
| 1P3D C24 | 10,073 | 1.06 / 2.19 s | 0.966 |

Compared with the earlier layout (sweep 38674332505: 1P1D on per-NIC 4 x 349 GiB pools, LMCache for 1P2D and 1P3D), 1P1D C112 rose from 36,779 to 39,245 tok/s/GPU and its TTFT p50 fell from 19.3 to 14.8 s; 1P2D C56 rose from 22,379 to 24,030; the other points are within 1%. Single-point runs of C112 tracked the Store's capacity rather than its layout: 38,905 with this 1536 GiB shared pool (run 39013224532) and 40,499 with per-NIC 4 x 448 GiB pools (1792 GiB, run 39002271840), whose model load stalled one prefill rank for 146 s. ATOM's CI reaches 46.1K at C112 with the same 1536 GiB, on another cluster whose owners use the decode NICs; that gap is not explained yet.

<details>
<summary>AI model disclosure</summary>

- Model/version: `claude-opus-5-5` (Claude Opus 5.5), running in Claude Code.
- Role: traced the InferenceX launcher and srt-slurm's ATOM backend, and wrote the recipe, the master config entry, the perf-changelog entry and the srt-slurm patch (NVIDIA/srt-slurm#604). It also rendered the bound recipes and srtctl mock launches, revised the recipe after a sweep-readiness review (shared hub cache, Store hugepage sizing, one Store variant), analysed the sweeps' LMCache startup hangs, ran the test runs above, moved every point to the Store with the #4211 DRAM budget, and gave 1P1D ATOM CI's shared Store pool.
- Delegated agent: a Claude Code Explore subagent surveyed srt-slurm's ATOM backend and service placement. The runtime did not expose its model identifier, so it could not be verified.

</details>

Optional modifiers `all-evals`, `evals-only`, and `agentx-fast` require a primary label; the last two block reuse while applied.
- [ ] **Before merging via reuse, an authorized maintainer (`OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`) has commented `/use <run_id>` (or the legacy `/reuse-sweep-run`) on this PR**. Do this **only once there is a final full sweep that is all green with evals passing**, since after this comment the primary sweep label will no longer automatically kick off new sweeps. Remove and re-add the primary sweep label to force a new sweep.

<summary>中文</summary>

## 概要

新增 `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg-agentic-mtp`：在 MI355X 上运行 GLM-5.2 MXFP4 的九个 AgentX 测试点，采用 ATOM 预填充/解码分离式推理，由 AToMesh 路由，通过 Mooncake RDMA 把 KV 从预填充传到解码，开启 MTP，并把预填充的前缀缓存放在 Mooncake Store 中。现有的 ATOM 配置在单节点上最高只到并发 10；这些测试点覆盖并发 12-128。

每个测试点都使用一个 CPP4 预填充 worker（GPU 0-3 上的 PP4 x TP1，层划分为 20/20/20/18）：

| 测试点 | 节点数 | 解码 | MTP | 预填充节点上的 Mooncake Store 0.3.13 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C56、C72、C96、C112、C128 | 1（1P1D） | TP4 + DCP4，使用预填充节点的 GPU 4-7 | 3 | 一个共享池，2 x 768 GiB |
| C56 | 3（1P2D） | 2 x TP4 + DCP4，各占一个节点 | 4 | 每块网卡一个池，4 x 349 GiB |
| C12、C16、C24 | 4（1P3D） | 3 x TP4，各占一个节点 | 5 | 每块网卡一个池，4 x 349 GiB |

- **Mooncake Store。** master 和 owner 均作为 `generic` service 运行在预填充节点上。1P1D 与 ATOM CI 一致，使用一个 master 和两个 768 GiB owner（每个 NUMA 节点一个），由四个 PP stage 共享；每个 owner 注册在 rdma0-3 上，预填充设置 `MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY`，使每个 stage 在这套按 rail 隔离的网络中通过同名网卡访问 owner。1P2D 和 1P3D 为每个预填充 stage 的网卡（rdma0-3）各启动一个 master 和一个 349 GiB owner，使每个 stage 在自己的 rail 上读取自己的池。owner 以 64 GiB 为单位注册其 segment，而 ionic 驱动只有在这些区域全部由 2 MiB 页组成时才能映射。因此 `host_setup` 参照 DSv4 UMBP 配方，通过集群的 `hugepage_sanity.sh` 预留 HugeTLB 大页：在主机服务已占用的大页（目前所见的 `mi355x-amds` 节点上为 5656 页）之上，预留 owner 所需的页数并多留 2%。只在 srtctl 启动预填充的 head 节点上预留（用 `SLURM_LAUNCH_NODE_IPADDR` 匹配本机地址，srun 未设置该变量时直接失败），随后检查每个 NUMA 节点上的份额，teardown 时再释放。owner 设置了 `MC_STORE_USE_HUGEPAGE=1`，大页不足时直接失败，不会退回 4 KiB 页；并且先执行 `ulimit -l unlimited`：重映射的容器 root 没有主机的 `CAP_IPC_LOCK`，注册该段会计入 `RLIMIT_MEMLOCK`。
- **内存预算。** 有了 #4211，`dram-utilization: 1.0` 为每个 4 卡服务器提供 1499 GB。1P1D 的解码与预填充同节点，因此其 owner 共占 1649 GB，每个 NUMA 节点 825 GB，落在预填充和解码各自的份额之内。1P2D 和 1P3D 的解码在各自的节点上，因此这些 owner 只占预填充的 1499 GB。
- **为什么不再用 LMCache。** LMCache 预填充注册 1 TiB pinned 池后，有时会在启动 barrier 永久卡住（`mi355x-amds` 上 8 次启动卡了 3 次）；Store 预填充从未出现这种情况。在相同测试点上 Store 不逊于 LMCache（见下文）。
- **模型与内存。** `mi355x-amds` 上没有预置的 `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4`；与单机 GLM-5.2 测试点一样，worker 从各节点本地的 hub 缓存读取模型（`/var/lib/hf-hub-cache` 挂载到 `$HF_HOME/hub`，这是 srtctl 预下载唯一能看到的路径），srtctl 会在 worker 启动前先补齐第一个节点的缓存。每个测试点的 `host_setup` 都会先重新运行集群的 `setup.sh` 清理页缓存，再预留大页。五个 1P1D 测试点共用一个配方变体，因此扫描只为它们运行一个 GSM8K eval。
- **srt-slurm 补丁。** srtctl 的 ATOM 后端把 worker 的 GPU 数直接作为 `-tp` 传入，PP4 预填充因此会以 `-tp 4 --pipeline-parallel-size 4` 启动（4 张 GPU 上 16 个 rank）。`runners/srt-slurm/patches/604-atom-tp-from-pp.patch` 携带 NVIDIA/srt-slurm#604，按 pipeline 和 prefill-context stage 数相除；在 v2.59.1 的固定版本上仍能打上。子模块的固定版本包含该 PR 后即可删除此补丁。
- **缓存命中率统计。** 本分支携带 #3964（cherry-pick 为 `4f75d941`，作者 Chun Fang），使本 PR 的 sweep 用它计算 ATOM P/D 的缓存命中率：只统计 prefill 端点，Store 的命中率取自 `atom:prefix_cache_offload_tokens`。#3964 合入后即可移除。
- 镜像为 `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202610131249`，按 digest 固定（ROCm/ATOM 6fd1bb1be）。

**在 `mi355x-amds` 上的运行。** 扫描 39028510364 以这一布局全部通过。每 GPU 吞吐与 TTFT p50/p90：

| 测试点 | tok/s/GPU | TTFT p50 / p90 | GSM8K（strict） |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1P1D C56 | 31,067 | 1.45 / 2.85 s | |
| 1P1D C72 | 38,487 | 1.93 / 4.00 s | |
| 1P1D C96 | 42,884 | 3.73 / 11.35 s | |
| 1P1D C112 | 39,245 | 14.78 / 26.70 s | |
| 1P1D C128 | 39,933 | 16.02 / 37.22 s | 0.962 |
| 1P2D C56 | 24,030 | 1.34 / 2.71 s | 0.965 |
| 1P3D C12 | 3,974 | 0.94 / 1.80 s | |
| 1P3D C16 | 6,481 | 0.94 / 2.00 s | 0.972 |
| 1P3D C24 | 10,073 | 1.06 / 2.19 s | 0.966 |

与之前的布局（扫描 38674332505：1P1D 用按网卡划分的 4 x 349 GiB 池，1P2D 和 1P3D 用 LMCache）相比，1P1D C112 从 36,779 升到 39,245 tok/s/GPU，TTFT p50 从 19.3 s 降到 14.8 s；1P2D C56 从 22,379 升到 24,030；其余测试点相差在 1% 以内。C112 的单点测试显示吞吐取决于 Store 的容量而非布局：本 PR 的 1536 GiB 共享池为 38,905（run 39013224532），按网卡划分的 4 x 448 GiB 池（1792 GiB）为 40,499（run 39002271840），但后者加载模型时有一个预填充 rank 卡了 146 s。ATOM CI 在另一个集群上用同样的 1536 GiB（owner 使用解码侧网卡）在 C112 跑到 46.1K，这一差距尚未查明。

## AI 模型使用说明

- 模型/版本：`claude-opus-5-5`（Claude Opus 5.5），在 Claude Code 中运行。
- 工作内容：梳理 InferenceX 启动器和 srt-slurm 的 ATOM 后端，编写配方、master 配置条目、perf-changelog 条目以及 srt-slurm 补丁（NVIDIA/srt-slurm#604），并生成绑定后的配方和 srtctl 模拟启动结果；根据扫描前的检查修订配方（共享 hub 缓存、Store 大页预留量、Store 共用一个变体）；分析扫描中 LMCache 的启动卡死，运行上述单点测试，按 #4211 的内存预算把所有测试点改为 Store，并为 1P1D 采用 ATOM CI 的共享 Store 池。
- 委派的 agent：一个 Claude Code Explore 子 agent 调研了 srt-slurm 的 ATOM 后端和 service 放置方式。运行环境没有提供它的模型标识，因此无法确认。

## 改动类型

新功能；配置变更。

</details>
